annotation.title_clean: Ethical and Moral Issues with AI - A Case Study on Healthcare Robots
annotation.title_en: Ethical and Moral Issues with AI - A Case Study on Healthcare Robots
annotation.venue: Americas Conference on Information Systems 2018 (AMCIS 2018), Association for Information Systems
annotation.summary_en: Research-in-progress conference paper from a repository record, proposing a qualitative interview study of AI experts, programmers, workers, union representatives and legislators on perceived ethical and moral issues of AI, using healthcare robots as the case, and on how to mitigate them. Only the abstract is available.
key_provisions_or_claims: Notes that low explainability, data security and privacy, and ethical problems of AI pose risks to users, developers and governments.
Plans qualitative interviews with experts, programmers, workers, labor unions, and legislators.
Asks what ethical and moral issues of AI are perceived and how they can be solved or attenuated.
Uses healthcare robots as the case study.
